purpose: Reconstruct exact pre-creation and pre-closure normative document versions and screen direct task-rule relevance, without calling validity or correct action.
rules: Temporal source proof requires a publicly queryable commit of the named document path strictly on or before the relevant event timestamp; current pinned source is not enough.
Temporal source proof is not a proof that the rule was adopted, in force, applicable to the particular code change or conclusive of any action.
Direct-topic is a proposed editorial case selection based on documented PR topic, not an independent human interpretation or scientific ground truth.
Missing historical document path or unrelated quoted clause excludes the current pairing from code-policy evaluation, but does not prove an alternate policy was absent.
All source checks are exploratory development-only. No authorisation labels in model-visible inputs, no human labels, no holdout, no changed original results.
